rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for deceiving someone or giving a false impression.

example.english: Don't mislead me; I'm not that easy to fool.
example.traditional: 你唔好呃人，我冇咁易信你。
example.jyutping: nei5 m4 hou2 aak1 jan4 ngo5 mou5 gam3 ji6 seon3 nei5

rows.note: Use this more formal direct verb when information, advice, or a person leads someone toward a wrong understanding or action.

example.english: This incorrect information may mislead the public.
example.traditional: 呢啲錯誤資料會誤導市民。
example.jyutping: ni1 di1 co3 ng6 zi1 liu2 wui5 ng6 dou6 si5 man4

rows.note: Use this spoken pattern specifically when someone is tricked into doing a wrong or harmful action.

example.english: They mislead me into buying fake goods.
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 aak1 ngo5 heoi3 maai5 gaa2 fo3

rows.note: Use this when something causes people to misunderstand, whether or not anyone intended to deceive them.

example.english: The way you put it can easily mislead people.
example.traditional: 你咁樣講，好容易令人誤會。
example.jyutping: nei5 gam2 joeng6 gong2 hou2 jung4 ji6 ling6 jan4 ng6 wui6
